Leonardo DiCaprio's Rolex 1908 Platinum, ref. 52506: spotted wearing it at the 2026 Oscars.

Platinum case, 39mm, ice-blue rice-grain dial. Ben Bridge lists it at $33,600 US (checked 21 Nov 2026); resale not checked.

Wear it or pass? Comment WEAR or PASS.

Source: spotted by Hypebeast (March 2026); specs from Watches of Switzerland; price from Ben Bridge.
